BASELINE-ARMA_BIC.name: ARMA with BIC Lag Selection
BASELINE-ARMA_BIC.method: Univariate ARMA model for each target. Lag orders (p, q) selected by minimizing the Bayesian Information Criterion over a grid search. Quantile forecasts from Gaussian predictive distribution.

BASELINE-Chronos.name: Chronos 2
BASELINE-Chronos.method: Zero-shot Chronos forecasts via FoundationForecast, using monthly log changes for INDPRO/CPIAUCSL/PCEPI and first differences for UNRATE.

BASELINE-TimesFM.name: TimesFM 2.5
BASELINE-TimesFM.method: Zero-shot TimesFM forecasts via FoundationForecast, using monthly log changes for INDPRO/CPIAUCSL/PCEPI and first differences for UNRATE.

BASELINE-Toto.name: Toto 1.0
BASELINE-Toto.method: Zero-shot Toto forecasts via FoundationForecast, using monthly log changes for INDPRO/CPIAUCSL/PCEPI and first differences for UNRATE.

MacroHub-Ensemble.name: Hub Ensemble
MacroHub-Ensemble.method: Equal-weighted quantile ensemble of all submitted models. Each quantile is computed as the median of the corresponding quantiles across contributing models.

MacroHub-RandomWalk.name: Random Walk
MacroHub-RandomWalk.method: Naive baseline. Growth/inflation targets (monthly log-change or change space): forecast equals the mean of the last 12 monthly changes (Atkeson-Ohanian naive). Level targets: last observed value (random walk). Prediction intervals are based on historical forecast errors of that rule.
